root_cause.text: In `drivers/net/ethernet/microsoft/mana/mana_en.c:add_adev()`, the cleanup path used `adev->id` after `auxiliary_device_uninit(adev)` had already triggered `adev_release()` to free the enclosing `struct mana_adev`, so an error in `auxiliary_device_add()` caused a use-after-free of the embedded auxiliary device structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch comment explicitly says `auxiliary_device_add()` failure falls through to `init_fail` after `auxiliary_device_uninit(adev)`, and since `adev_release()` frees `struct mana_adev`, accessing `adev->id` is unsafe; the fix saves `adev->id` into a local `id` before the add call and changes `mana_adev_idx_free(adev->id)` to `mana_adev_idx_free(id)`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the error path in `add_adev()` to free the correct auxiliary device index during initialization failure.

intent_record.how: This changes cleanup behavior so the allocated auxiliary device index is freed using the original index value even if `adev->id` is not reliable at failure time, preventing incorrect index release during initialization failure handling.
